statement: Unrestricted generic complementary affine linear sections of SO(2,C) have monodromy S_2.

source.location: Proposition 1.1; Bertini reduction explained in the family result

notes:
Deduction, not a named SO case in Kadets: take a general integral curve section of the irreducible projective closure; its variable-hyperplane monodromy S_D embeds in the unrestricted section monodromy. Restricting to the open set of affine sections missing infinity preserves this conclusion. Degree from Brandt et al. Theorem 1.1/Table 1.

LMFDB identification: 2T1 in the recorded permutation degree. Standard generating permutations, when newly supplied here, are an abstract relabeling of the proved group action; they are not additional path-tracking data.

This is a catalogue application of the classical characteristic-zero sectional-monodromy theorem, called folklore in Kadets, Proposition 1.1. Kadets is cited for an explicit proof, not as the originator of that theorem; the stated Bertini reduction identifies the particular enumerative family.
scope: Unrestricted complementary affine linear sections; no restriction to coordinate projections or homogeneous slices.
